findings.evidence: Lines 89–96 use only `explicitRes1_mk`, equality of the restricted cochains, and the supplied `hy`; `explicitRes1` itself is declared for `[Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]` with `ContinuousSMul` coefficients, while `evensHomCocycle` and `evensHomCocycleAmbient` are likewise defined without `IsTopologicalGroup G`.
findings.fix: Move this lemma to a section with only `[TopologicalSpace G]`, supplying the continuous trivial action directly if instance synthesis requires it; retain `[IsTopologicalGroup G]` only for the graph-class results below.
findings.issue: `explicitRes1_evensHomCocycle` inherits `[IsTopologicalGroup G]`, although restriction of this trivial-coefficient cocycle only needs `[TopologicalSpace G]`; continuity of multiplication and inversion are irrelevant.

summary: The restriction lemma is stated under an unnecessarily strong topological-group assumption.
